description: Findings (2026-10-13): mix test does not run the fuzzy_search app. test_helper.exs and 3 test files (resume, elixir_mode, value_semantics; agreement uses it too) Code.require_file only examples/fuzzy_search/lib/fuzzy_search/kernels.ex (106 lines, one module) as a realistic yielding kernel. The app's own test (examples/fuzzy_search/test, Plug + Bandit, /usr/share/dict/words 234k words, compares 3 backends with a full scan) never runs in CI. Decide and implement: keep kernels.ex in mix test (cheap, real kernel) or replace it with a fixture; run the app's tests in the examples task (cd examples/fuzzy_search && mix test) or not at all; check the app still compiles against the current defk.

comments.text: Decision (maintainer, 2026-10-13): keep examples/fuzzy_search/lib/fuzzy_search/kernels.ex in mix test (cheap, real yielding kernel); the app's own tests (Plug, Bandit, /usr/share/dict/words) run only in mix defk.examples (defk-30c.3), not in mix ci.

Done (2026-10-13, no code change): mix test keeps kernels.ex as is. The app compiles against main 129ce44 (path dep ../..) and its own tests pass: (cd examples/fuzzy_search && mix deps.get && mix test) -> 7 passed, ~10 s wall incl. compile, load ~10 (provisional). _build and deps there are gitignored; the tree stays clean. For defk-30c.3: run exactly that command in mix defk.examples; it needs /usr/share/dict/words (present on macOS; on Debian install the 'wamerican' package) — check what the app does when the file is missing.

title: fuzzy_search in CI: keep kernels.ex as a test fixture, move the app's tests out
